name: NGC 5754, SN 2021mnj field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5754, the galaxy that hosted the Type II supernova SN 2021mnj, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2021mnjhost-hubble
story: Hubble returned to NGC 5754 long after the Type II supernova SN 2021mnj exploded there, to measure the radioactive material the blast left behind and to study its surroundings.

claims.text: SN 2021mnj is a Type II supernova in the galaxy NGC 5754
Hubble program 16691 takes late-time snapshots of recent transients to measure radioactive material and probe their environments
